title: Senior Software Engineer
description_text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Job Description

Okta is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build, style, and maintain our documentation site’s frontend, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and publishing processes. You will manage and scale our product and developer documentation platforms and support internal customers such as the Information Development technical writers and other Builder Experience teams who contribute to Okta’s product content. You will also implement frontend changes to improve the user experience, appearance, and functionality on the help.okta.com and developer.okta.com sites.

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Work Mode: Hybrid (minimum of 2 days onsite per week)

 

Key Responsibilities

A Senior Software Engineer at Okta is responsible for building, maintaining, and improving the infrastructure for technical documentation sites. This includes:

  • Building, maintaining, and improving the documentation site’s infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes.
  • Supporting internal customers such as the Builder Experience teams with their structured authoring platforms and automation. Ensuring the technical writers are not blocked in their day-to-day work.
  • Providing cross-regional support to various Builder Experience teams.
  • Collaborating with DocTool Leads to maintain and improve the user experience for Okta's documentation sites, supporting content structure, and versioning for multiple products and global audiences.

 

Minimum knowledge, skills, and abilities

The ideal candidate should have at least 4+ years of development experience and proficiency in the following skills:

  • Programming languages: JavaScript/TypeScript and Python
  • Technologies: OpenAPI and the JAMstack architecture
  • Frameworks: DITA, Redocly, VuePress, or any similar documentation framework
  • CI/CD tools: Experience with tools like GitHub, CircleCI, Vercel, and Artifactory
  • AI Tools: Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools to assist with coding, workflow automation, and tooling enhancements
  • Good verbal communication skills
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with members in various teams
  • Experience working in an agile environment

 

Desired knowledge

  • Experience working with technical writers and knowledge of the documentation process
  • Localization experience

 

Education
A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience, is required for this role.
